xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
We received a show cause notice from Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI), Kolkata Unit, stating wrong availment of IGST refund on export benefit of Rs. 34,45,97,088/- and sought the reply of the company on the same.
On 23/05/2022, company filed its reply to the show-cause denying all allegations and rectifying the quantum of alleged liability as per DRI should be Rs 33,68,27,914/-. After doing the hearings, taking on record our submissions, the DRI passed its order confirming the above demand on 20/09/2022 received to us on 19/10/2022.
We have filed an appeal against the said order on 28/12/2022. The company has also filed a writ petition in Bombay High Court for stay on recoveries and to cancel the proceedings on 15/03/2021, the same is pending for hearing. The company has received ad-interim relief on stay of recovery. The Writ in Bombay High Court is pending for hearing.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The company has filed an appeal against the order on 28/12/2022 and the same is pending for hearing. We are awaiting the hearing date from the commissioner appeals, surat. Also, on the same matter the company has filed writ with Bombay HC challenging the vires of the notification under dispute and the same is pending for hearing. The last hearing date was 07/04/2025, wherein the Hon’ble HC has confirmed the Ad-interim relief on the proceedings till 10/06/2025 the next hearing.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs:
A Show Cause Notice was received from Directorate of Revenue Intelligence (DRI) Dt 13/10/2020 in respect of exemption from payment of IGST availed on the basis of Advanced Authorisation and pre-import conditions under the Customs Act and the Foreign Trade Policy. The DRI determined the amount of Rs. 8,22,26,562/- as IGST saved on imports during the FY 2017-18 and FY 2018-19 as being recoverable.
As the issue has already been decided in favor of the company by the Gujarat HC and the SC has also pronounced to reverify claims on case-to-case basis.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The Supreme court has passed the order on 28/04/2023 upholding the vires of the customs notification and directed the officer to reverify claims on case-to-case basis. We have filed a detailed rejoinder on the matter with the Commissioner of Customs on 26th march, 2025 and awaiting further steps from their office.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:StatusOfTheLitigationDisputeAs: There was a dispute with the import of goods from customs with regards to the declaration of goods made by the company during the FY 2014-15. The same was accepted and all the import duty dues were paid in full by the company. Vide customs order Dt 28/03/2018 the customs have further levied penalty on the said dues, which remains in dispute.
xbrli:xbrl.in-capmkt:CurrentStatusOfTheLitigationOr: The company has filed its appeal in the CESTAT and the issue stands pending till date. The company expects the outcome to be positive as all the dues were duly paid and the penalty has no grounds to stand on. Hence, no provision is made for the same in the books.
